_comment: Proposed entry for charlesvestal/schwung module-catalog.json - submit as a PR only after Gus validates the release on his Move and says GO.
name: 6W6
description: TR-606 style drum machine - synthesized kick, snare, toms, hats and cymbal, fitted to a real 606. Reverb and delay sends on every voice, 7 distortion types per voice and on the master, bus compressor, switchable hat choke.
author: athousanddetails; voices after 606-Inspired-Synth-Drums (Matthew Fecher / AudioKit Pro)
